National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 (NLSY97)

BLS's panel survey of about 9,000 people born in 1980-84, interviewed annually from 1997 to 2011 and every two years since; managed by CHRR at The Ohio State University, interviews by NORC.

Publisher
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS); produced and distributed by the Center for Human Resource Research (CHRR), The Ohio State University
Dataset
https://www.nlsinfo.org/content/cohorts/nlsy97
Terms
https://www.nlsinfo.org/content/getting-started/accessing-data
What NLS says (read 2026-11-20): public-use data are available at no cost through the NLS Investigator, and whole-cohort files are posted for download (https://www.nlsinfo.org/content/access-data-investigator/accessing-data-cohorts); "It is not necessary to get an account to browse data, but an account is necessary to save datasets online" (https://www.nlsinfo.org/content/getting-started/accessing-data). The suggested citation is at https://www.nlsinfo.org/bibliography/citing-nls-data. The site's System Use Notification limits use of the Investigator to "intended, lawful purposes". No statement about redistributing the public-use files was found. Geocode data are restricted (a separate application) and aren't used here.
Citation
Bureau of Labor Statistics, U.S. Department of Labor. National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 cohort, 1997-2023 (rounds 1-21). Produced and distributed by the Center for Human Resource Research (CHRR), The Ohio State University. Columbus, OH.
wave
survey year — Each survey year is one round: rounds 1-15 were annual (1997-2011), rounds 16-21 every two years (2013-2023). Each codebook entry gives its survey year; a question asked each round has a different reference number (column) in each.
